title: Little A'Le'Inn: we made a digital copy

tellings.quote: she was like you think we're that stupid you don't think we would have made a digital copy

plain: At the Little A'Le'Inn, a small roadside inn in the desert town of Rachel, Nevada, a woman told a UFO investigator named James Fox, in 2023, that of course they had made a digital copy of a VHS tape recorded by a man named Chuck Clark. Fox tells it first-hand, saying she answered him, "you think we're that stupid," which suggests the footage on the tape was guarded and kept safe in more than one form.
